p: baskets of figs were set before: The good figs signified them that were gone into captivity and so saved their life, as in Jer 21:8, and the bad figs them that remained, who were yet subject to the sword, famine and pestilence.
place into the land of the: By which he approves the yielding of Jeconiah and his company because they obeyed the prophet, who exhorted them to it.
an heart to know me: Which declares that man of himself can know nothing till God gives the heart and understanding.
in the land of Egypt: Who fled there for comfort.
